blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Calls for justice and condolences have been expressed following the reported killing of Cebuano pro-Duterte vlogger and commentator Philip Engbino, who was reportedly shot while driving along a national highway in Carrascal, Surigao del Sur, on Sunday morning, October 4.
